description: This file contains conversion functions for Kubernetes API objects in the apps/v1beta1 version, including functions to convert ScaleStatus and StatefulSetSpec objects between different API versions, and to add field label conversions.

methods.name: addConversionFuncs
methods.description: Adds field label conversion functions to the scheme for StatefulSet kind.

methods.name: Convert_autoscaling_ScaleStatus_To_v1beta1_ScaleStatus
methods.description: Converts autoscaling.ScaleStatus to v1beta1.ScaleStatus, including parsing the selector string.

methods.name: Convert_v1beta1_ScaleStatus_To_autoscaling_ScaleStatus
methods.description: Converts v1beta1.ScaleStatus to autoscaling.ScaleStatus, handling selector string or label map.

methods.name: Convert_v1beta1_StatefulSetSpec_To_apps_StatefulSetSpec
methods.description: Converts v1beta1 StatefulSetSpec to apps/v1beta1 StatefulSetSpec, preserving <1.17 behavior for nested volume claim templates.

methods.name: Convert_apps_StatefulSetSpec_To_v1beta1_StatefulSetSpec
methods.description: Converts apps/v1beta1 StatefulSetSpec to v1beta1 StatefulSetSpec, setting apiVersion and kind in nested volume claim templates for <1.17 behavior.
